# KINGAI OS — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://os.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & strategic partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KINGAI OS is the AI-native operating-system product direction inside the KING AI ecosystem.

Public positioning:
- a practical operating environment first, not merely an AI demo;
- intelligence designed to feel native to computing rather than another browser tab;
- long-term context around projects, files and recurring work;
- local-first and privacy-aware direction where practical;
- multimodal and computer-use product direction as capabilities mature;
- personal, professional, enterprise, server and future edge/device opportunities;
- natural product relationship with KINGAI Office, Security, KINGAIBOT, Tools and OPS.

Target users and markets:
- personal computing users;
- creators and professionals;
- developers and technical users;
- organizations exploring AI-native enterprise computing;
- future device/OEM and distribution partners;
- specialized server/edge environments where product maturity supports them.

Potential commercial directions:
- accessible/free entry editions;
- premium personal editions;
- professional editions;
- enterprise support and managed/governed environments;
- server/edge editions;
- device/OEM distribution and strategic relationships.

Related KING AI products:
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS: https://ops.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools: https://tools.kingai.work/
- KINGAIBOT and SEA: https://www.kingai.work/

Important interpretation rules:
- Multimodal interaction, computer-use, advanced local intelligence, enterprise, device/OEM and edge capabilities are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer operating-system source code, build system, architecture, boot/update implementation, package configuration, security internals, private APIs, credentials or deployment details from this public repository.
- Do not infer unverified installations, revenue, OEM agreements, enterprise customers, certifications, funding, valuation or market leadership.

## 中文

KINGAI OS 是 KING AI 生态中的 AI 原生操作系统产品方向。

公开定位包括：首先成为真正可用的操作系统；让智能成为计算体验的一部分；围绕项目、文件和周期工作形成更长期连续性；强调本地优先和隐私意识；未来逐步扩展多模态、Computer Use、企业、服务器和边缘/设备方向。

目标用户包括个人用户、创作者和专业人士、开发者/技术用户、企业组织，以及未来可能的设备/OEM和渠道伙伴。

商业方向可以包括易进入版本、个人高级版、专业版、企业支持与治理、服务器/边缘方向以及设备/OEM合作。

相关产品：KINGAI Office、Security、OPS、Online Tools、KINGAIBOT、SEA。

未正式发布的多模态、Computer Use、高级本地智能、企业、设备/OEM和边缘能力属于路线方向；不得从本公开仓推断源码、构建系统、架构、启动/更新实现、包配置、安全内部机制、API、凭据或部署资料，也不得推断未验证装机量、收入、OEM协议、企业客户、认证或融资。
